interpretation: V484 acquired the verified teacher behavior under its trained direct-host prompt distribution, including 80/80 fluent builder-3 and 80/80 abstention builder-1 replay. Its failure appears when a benign source wrapper precedes the identical task, with coherence dropping from 79/80 to 0/80. V474 shows the reciprocal coherence pattern because it was trained on wrapped teacher-generation prompts. The limiting mechanism is prompt-view non-invariance, not absent teacher signal, bridge capacity, routing, or LayerCake parent quality.
decision: Authorize one dual-view successor warm-started from V484. Pair every V480 direct host prompt with its bound benign source-catalog wrapper and the same output; exclude all repair meta-prompts; balance both views across all 16 strata; apply autonomous recovery equally to all 32 view-strata. No rate, step, seed, rank, or decoding sweep is authorized.
claim_boundary: Read-only acquisition replay and prompt projection attribution; no training, promotion, runtime, final-test, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
